verdict.rationale: GitBook ships some built-in, event-driven automation: auto translations keep localized docs current as content changes, the GitBook Agent flags outdated content and drafts fixes, and Git Sync keeps content synchronized with repositories. However, nothing shows a user-facing way to define their own rules or triggers that fire actions on events. missing for 10: user-configurable rule/trigger definitions, documented event types and actions (e.g. webhooks or workflow automation), independent or hands-on corroboration.
